title: Design: the call list for one customer matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on, so the credit term shows.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with a long name, an overdue invoice, a phone number and a credit term.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design picture "Call list on A/R Collection" (ar-ap-p7-call-list-on-a-r-collection.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
custom_steps: 1. In the Customer filter, tick customer A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Only customer A's group is listed.
  • As in the picture: the chip reads "Customer: " and customer A's name, shortened with "...", in a blue pill.
  • A closed group row: a chevron pointing right, the bold name and count, grey "Phone: " and the number, grey "Credit term: " and the term, "Total" and the sums.
  • The Totals row equals the group's sums.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”
  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"; as there, the search box shows only when there are more than 8 vendors). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-call-list-on-a-r-collection.png: figure "Call list on A/R Collection" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-collection-date-and-customer-only.png: figure "A/R Collection: date and customer only" (Production (before)), board "7. Filters and call list" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
  • "Collection and Unpaid Invoices have a customer or vendor picker, and their Totals row ignores it. No phone or credit term on the customer rows." (caption of "A/R Collection: date and customer only")

Design note (DR-03): the design shows with one name ticked the chip keeps its prefix: "Location: Staging Lethbri...", "Customer: 10 Trucking", "Customer: Andrews' Truck ...". Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R6 / S5-R13 say the chip shows "the name" and the chips are "exactly as on Sales By Customer"; the design shows how (prefix kept, shortened with "..."). Cases now say what the picture shows.
